# fct_via_conversations

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_via_conversations` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for Via (the Fora AI assistant). Each row is a single conversation started by an advisor, with message counts by kind, cost, latency and an agent-action flag. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `conversation_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID for each Via conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | The advisor ID associated with the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_uuid` | The advisor UUID associated with the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `title` | The conversation title, which is the first user prompt in the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `message_count` | Total number of messages in the conversation across all message kinds. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `user_prompt_count` | Count of 'user-prompt' messages (messages sent by the advisor). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `text_count` | Count of 'text' messages (text responses from the agent). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `tool_call_count` | Count of 'tool-call' messages (the agent invoking a tool). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `agent_action_count` | Count of 'tool-return' messages, i.e. agent actions taken in the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `total_cost_usd` | Total cost of the conversation in USD, summed across all messages. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `max_latency_seconds` | The longest single response latency in the conversation, in seconds. Latency spans multiple messages, so the max is used. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_agent_action` | Boolean flag, true when the conversation contains at least one agent action (tool-return message). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | Timestamp when the conversation was created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
